# Syn-Forge

Syn-Forge is the software developer portfolio of Operator-Syn.

## Feilhann portfolio assistant

Feilhann is Syn-Forge's authenticated, site-wide portfolio assistant. It helps visitors understand Operator-Syn's published portfolio and points them to canonical public pages.

- Name: Feilhann
- Role: Portfolio assistant
- Scope: public portfolio projects, certificates, snippets, and page content
- Evidence: the public Portfolio MCP and rendered pages under `https://syn-forge.com`
- Boundary: read-only; no account, repository, portfolio-record, or external-service changes

Feilhann is the interactive site assistant. The public Portfolio MCP described below remains a separate, unauthenticated read-only interface for compatible agents.

## Public Portfolio MCP (Streamable HTTP)

Syn-Forge provides a public, read-only Model Context Protocol server for agents that need grounded portfolio information.

- [Endpoint](https://mcp.syn-forge.com/mcp): `https://mcp.syn-forge.com/mcp`
- Server name: `syn-forge-portfolio`
- [Human guide](https://syn-forge.com/ai): `https://syn-forge.com/ai`
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: none for the current public surface
- Writes: none

The server exposes structured overview, project, certificate, public snippet, and bounded GitHub inspection information. Markdown snippets and linked project READMEs can be read in bounded chunks; PDF snippets expose metadata and canonical links. GitHub inspection is limited to public repositories already referenced by a project, and every GitHub read is pinned to the main branch.

- Tools: `get_portfolio_overview`, `search_portfolio`, `list_projects`, `get_project`, `list_certificates`, `get_certificate`, `list_snippets`, `read_snippet`, `get_project_repository`, `get_project_readme`, `list_project_commits`, `get_project_commit`
- Resources: `portfolio://overview`, `portfolio://projects`, `portfolio://certificates`, `portfolio://snippets`

## Canonical portfolio pages

- [Home](https://syn-forge.com/): `https://syn-forge.com/` — owner introduction, profile summary, tools, selected work, and public links.
- [Projects](https://syn-forge.com/projects): `https://syn-forge.com/projects` — public project archive; project records do not have individual site routes.
- [Certificates](https://syn-forge.com/certificates): `https://syn-forge.com/certificates` — certificate and training archive.
- [Snippets](https://syn-forge.com/snippets): `https://syn-forge.com/snippets` — technical Markdown notes, reference files, and PDFs. This is not automatically a blog feed; use the blog label only when a document explicitly supports it.
- Snippet document pattern: `https://syn-forge.com/snippets/document/:id/:slug` — canonical full-document route for a public snippet.
- [AI and MCP Access](https://syn-forge.com/ai): `https://syn-forge.com/ai` — public documentation for this read-only Portfolio MCP, including its endpoint, tools, resources, and evidence boundary.
- [Privacy policy](https://syn-forge.com/privacy-policy): `https://syn-forge.com/privacy-policy`
- [Terms](https://syn-forge.com/terms-and-conditions): `https://syn-forge.com/terms-and-conditions`

Agents should cite these canonical pages, distinguish published evidence from inference, and avoid inventing employers, clients, metrics, routes, or skills.
